query: For my 94yo female ICU patient, among female ICU patients aged 89–99 report per-measurement temperature categories (<36, 36–37.9, ≥38°C) with mean, median, IQR, unique patient and measurement counts, MI rate.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.age, i.itemid, l.value AS temperature, COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id) AS unique_patients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.labevent_id) AS unique_measurements, AVG(l.value) AS average_temperature, MEDIAN(l.value) AS median_temperature, (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value)) AS interquartile_range, SUM(CASE WHEN i.itemid = 718747 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mi_rate FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON i.subject_id = l.subject_id AND i.hadm_id = l.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.age >= 89 AND p.age <= 99 AND l.value >= 32 AND l.value <= 37.9 AND i.stay_id IN (SELECT stay_id FROM icustays WHERE subject_id = p.subject_id) GROUP BY p.gender, p.age, i.itemid, l.value;
